categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of OLED organic materials, including OLED terminal materials and OLED intermediates. It also produces pharmaceutical intermediates and electronic special materials. The business is structured around OLED organic materials as the core product line, serving the display panel industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced OLED organic material synthesis, purification, and device fabrication technologies, including vacuum evaporation and sublimation purification. It has developed proprietary high-purity Red Prime, Green Host, and Red Host materials, and is advancing blue phosphorescent materials and tandem device materials. The company integrates AI and machine learning in its R&D platform to optimize material design and production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic OLED panel manufacturers such as BOE, Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics, and Xinli. The end markets include smartphones, tablets, laptops, automotive displays, and wearable devices. The company also serves overseas customers for OLED intermediates and pharmaceutical intermediates, expanding its international footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. It serves domestic OLED panel manufacturers and has established cooperation with overseas clients for intermediate materials. Its patent protection and market reach extend to China, the US, Japan, Korea, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the OLED supply chain, producing core OLED organic materials and intermediates essential for panel manufacturing. It integrates the entire production chain from intermediate synthesis to terminal material fabrication, providing a one-stop supply solution for OLED panel makers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in OLED organic materials, focusing on red, green, and blue phosphorescent materials, tandem device materials, and TADF materials for high color gamut displays. The company invests heavily in R&D, leveraging AI and machine learning, and collaborates with leading universities and industry partners to maintain technological leadership and expand product portfolios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of OLED organic materials and intermediates to panel manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies. The company employs a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders with a focus on long-term supply contracts and product customization. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic OLED organic material supplier, recognized for breaking foreign patent monopolies and achieving domestic substitution. It competes with international material suppliers but holds a strong position in China due to its proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and close cooperation with major panel manufacturers. It is positioned as a technology-driven, high-quality supplier in the OLED materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 471.77 million, a 56.9% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 167.32 million, up 117.17%. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased OLED terminal material sales and improved operational efficiency. It maintains a solid asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 2.1 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary OLED organic materials with high purity, efficiency, and stability, enabling domestic substitution of imported products. Its integrated production chain ensures quality control and cost advantages. The company’s strong patent portfolio and collaborative R&D with customers and academia provide differentiated technological leadership and customized solutions, enhancing customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
